question: Should OpenClaw add a model-facing parent-only sub-agent send contract, and should the permanent API be a dedicated sessions_send_parent tool or a reserved sessionKey:"parent" selector on sessions_send?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the final shape changes session authorization and model-facing tool semantics across parent/child agent boundaries.

options.title: Add a dedicated parent-only contract
options.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and forwarded targets.

options.title: Reserve sessionKey:"parent"
options.body: Keep one sessions_send tool but make parent a trusted selector resolved from sub-agent metadata rather than a literal user-supplied session key.

options.title: Decline native mid-run sends
options.body: Keep child-originated mid-run sends unsupported and document completion handoff, sessions_yield, or explicit trusted operator opt-ins as the supported paths.

recommendation.title: Add a dedicated parent-only contract
recommendation.body: Implement a dedicated tool or trusted parent selector that derives the direct parent from active spawn metadata and rejects missing, stale, sibling, ancestor, cross-agent, and forwarded targets.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is most directly connected to recent sessions_send, session resolution, visibility hardening, and docs contract history for the requested API.
